value.rationale: Quantitative invariant-variance bias is a natural equilibrium observable for long-memory numerical SDEs. The exact parameter c=1/12 uniquely cancels the midpoint O(h²) defect inside a meaningful theta family, and the remaining sharp Hurst-dependent exponent shows an intrinsic mismatch between high-order deterministic propagation and unchanged correlated fBm increments. The coefficient is a reference benchmark for numerical validation and design.
